cause_quote: The new assignment `raw.compat === undefined && catalogModel?.compat !== undefined ? catalogModel.compat : undefined` copied compatibility from a provider-and-model ID match without checking the configured API or endpoint.
user_saw: Tool Search could disappear when a custom model endpoint inherited the standard endpoint’s Code Mode preference.
summary: The fix binds catalog compatibility to the selected API and physical endpoint, recognizes equivalent Anthropic URLs, and preserves explicit compatibility settings on custom endpoints.
reasoning: I checked #126068 and its parent: config defaults previously left omitted compatibility absent, and the route-aware resolver used only configured compatibility when the selected endpoint differed from the catalog endpoint. #126068 copied catalog flags into the configured model before resolution, so the resolver treated those flags as operator-authored on the custom route. The fix also addresses separate resolver cases involving Anthropic URL aliases and discovery returning a different route.
